data.name: Ashrose Manor - A Portrait of Forbidden Love
data.detailed_description:
Enter a manor where every portrait hides a secret.

In Ashrose Manor – A Portrait of Forbidden Love, you step into a decaying family estate haunted not by monsters, but by silence. The Ashrose family has preserved its legacy in oil, wood, and dust — yet one name has been scratched away, one portrait has vanished, and one forbidden love was never meant to be remembered.

As Evelyn, you arrive at Ashrose Manor and begin piecing together the truth hidden within its halls. Examine portraits, read forgotten journal entries, investigate old guest books, and uncover the story of Julian Vale, a restorer whose presence in the manor was deliberately erased.

Investigate. Collect clues. Rebuild the past.

Explore atmospheric rooms such as the entrance hall and the artist’s studio, where the manor’s most important secret waits to be uncovered. Every object can become a clue: an overpainted nameplate, a missing frame, a guest book entry from 1954, or a torn fragment of a painting.

Your journal acts as both your memory and your investigation board. Important discoveries are automatically recorded, allowing you to connect clues and unlock new conclusions as the story unfolds. This matches the intended journal-based clue system, where evidence such as Julian Vale, the overpainted nameplate, and the missing portrait lead to a larger realization.

Restore the portrait. Reveal the forbidden love.

At the heart of the prototype is a focused mystery loop: explore the manor, find fragments, restore a painting, and uncover what the Ashrose family tried to hide. The planned mini-prototype centers on a main menu, an intro, the entrance hall, the atelier, one central puzzle, a journal, a memory scene, and a final teaser ending.

The deeper you investigate, the clearer it becomes: Julian Vale was not just a visitor. His connection to the family was dangerous enough to be erased from every wall, every record, and every memory.

Features

  • Explore an atmospheric gothic manor in first person

  • Investigate portraits, documents, and environmental clues

  • Record discoveries and connect clues through your journal

  • Solve environmental and narrative puzzles

  • Restore a mysterious portrait to uncover lost memories

  • Discover a story of forbidden love, secrecy, and loss

About the Prototype

This playable prototype offers an early look at the atmosphere, exploration, storytelling, and mystery mechanics of Ashrose Manor – A Portrait of Forbidden Love.

The game is currently in development, so content, visuals, mechanics, and performance may change in future versions.

If you enjoy the prototype, consider wishlisting Ashrose Manor – A Portrait of Forbidden Love on Steam.

Credits

Special thanks and credits to:

LUMI Studio, Pablo Wunderlich, artsystack, Ida Faber, Art Equilibrium

Generative AI was used to assist in the creation of selected 2D images, sprite assets, and marketing artwork, including some Steam capsule and store assets. It was also used for proofreading and editing written text. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, selected, and refined by the developer before being included in the game or official marketing materials.

data.short_description: Ashrose Manor – A Portrait of Forbidden Love is a first-person gothic mystery about memory, loss, and a love the Ashrose family tried to erase. Explore a forgotten manor, uncover hidden clues, restore a damaged portrait, and reveal the truth behind Julian Vale’s disappearance from history.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
